headline: HuyenBao v11.54 — navigation audit + Guide popup clickable + mobile compact
summary: NAVIGATION FIX PASS. Audited every clickable element in the app and fixed broken links. The Finance Overview 'Kids' expense row was linking to 'life' (a GROUP id, not a tab id) — clicking it showed a blank screen; now links to 'home'. The MoreInfoPopup Guide section had 5 static business images that didn't navigate — now each image is a button that closes the popup and jumps to the Business tab. The LinksTab systems-map SVG nodes were display-only — now every node (edu/job/biz/space/health/level/club/fame/spirit/social/bank/charity/income) is clickable and navigates to its corresponding tab. Mobile Guide popup display tightened: 2-column image grid (was auto-fill), smaller images (62px vs 92px), tighter text, horizontal-scrolling section tabs.
features: FIX: Finance Overview 'Kids' expense row link 'life' → 'home' (was a GROUP id, not a tab id — clicking showed blank screen)
NEW: MoreInfoPopup Guide section images are now clickable buttons — tap a business image to close the popup + jump to the Business tab
NEW: LinksTab systems-map SVG nodes are now clickable — every node (edu/job/biz/space/health/level/club/fame/spirit/social/bank/charity/income) navigates to its corresponding tab
NEW: LinksTab hover effect on clickable nodes (accent-color glow on the rect)
NEW: onNav prop threaded through HomeTab → MoreInfoPopup + LinksTab so all clickable elements can navigate
NEW: ln.sub i18n updated to mention 'Tap any node to jump to its tab' (EN/VI/中文)
